class Greeter {
  greet(name = "you") {
    return `Hello, ${name}`;
  }
}
class LoudGreeter extends Greeter {
  greet(name = "you", times: number) {
    return `HELLO, ${name}`.repeat(times);
  }
}
const handler: (value?: number) => void = (value = 1, label: string) => {};
function pad(width = 2, text: string) {
  return text.padStart(width);
}
const formatter: (text: string) => string = pad;
const strict: (width: number | undefined, text: string) => string = pad;
console.log(strict(undefined, "a"));
